title: a path crosses the inspect wire by its root, not by the asking box's disk
intention: A Path that crosses codemother's inspect wire from under a known root (the caller's cairn checkout or its CairnCommons) arrives as that root plus a relative path, and the answering judge resolves it against its own checkout of the same root; a path under no known root is refused loudly at the wire, never resolved as a missing file.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akienasus: CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419, so /sorted's reason_has_referent (skills/sorted/door.py:64) asks the Dell's codemother over inspect, the Path crosses as its plain string (inspect_wire.py:31 {'__wire__':'path','v':str(value)}), and /home/akien/cairn/... does not exist on the Dell, so every 'none, because <repo path>' reason is refused as having no referent. Ticket-id referents still resolve. Every judge taking a Path answers from the wrong disk whenever caller and bus host differ; a Windows caller (C:\automation\local\cairn) sends backslashes no Linux judge can open.
traces_to: Law 3 (a judge's answer is a measurement of the caller's world, so it must read the same file the caller named); Law 7 (a path the wire cannot place is refused by name, never answered False); RULE 1 (the fix lives in the one module holding both directions of the wire, so no judge or door patches it alone).
how: In cairn/tools/inspect_wire/inspect_wire.py, the path kind changes shape: wire_encode resolves a Path and, when it lies under one of the known roots, sends {'__wire__':'path','root':'cairn'|'CairnCommons','rel':<posix relpath>}; wire_decode joins rel (split on both / and \) onto its own checkout of that root. The known roots are named in one function, _roots(), returning {'cairn': the checkout this module is imported from (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]), 'CairnCommons': cairn.tools.edges.edges.commons_root()} (a tool using a tool). A Path under neither root raises ValueError naming the path at encode; a decoded root the answerer does not know raises at decode. A relative Path is resolved against cwd before the test. The old {'v': str} form is gone (no compatibility lane: both directions ship in one module). The proof drives the codec with caller and answerer roots set to two different scratch trees (by monkeypatching _roots per side), and asks reason_has_referent through ask() in a launched codemother whose roots differ from the caller's.

clauses.claim: a Path under the caller's cairn root, encoded with caller roots A and decoded with answerer roots B, rebuilds as the same relative path under B's cairn root; likewise for CairnCommons

the /sorted 'none, because <repo path>' reason naming a file that exists under the answerer's checkout but at a different absolute path than the caller's is judged True through ask() (a launched codemother whose roots differ from the caller's)
an absolute Path under neither known root raises ValueError naming it at wire_encode, and an encoded path naming an unknown root raises at wire_decode; neither is ever answered False
a path kind whose rel carries backslashes (a Windows caller) decodes on Linux to the same file as its forward-slash spelling

decisions.text: D1: the path kind crosses as {root, rel}; _roots() names the two known roots; an unplaceable path raises at encode, an unknown root at decode; the charter's 'A Path crosses as its string' line and falsifier are updated in the same act.

D2: a NEW proof, one tooth per clause; the existing proofs (test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother.py, codemother's test_codemother_answers_inspect_over_the_bus.py tooth 3) are re-run, and are edited only if their Path tooth reads the old {'v'} form.

out: skills/sorted/door.py (read only: the fix is at the wire, not the door)
cairn/devices/codemother (her verb decodes through this module unchanged)

measured.saw: /sorted refused every 'none, because <path>' field cast from akienasus while ticket-id referents passed; CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419 and no codemother runs on akienasus
measured.how: env | grep CAIRN_BUS on akienasus; skills/sorted/door.py:64 reason_has_referent -> ask_inspector; inspect_wire.py:31 encodes str(value); the 9f5bb43e8a64 cast refused on akienasus and passed on the Dell
